info.name: WalletPesa API
info.description: Spring Boot backend, all endpoints under /api/v1. Sign in with Auth > Login (phone + PIN); the access token is saved to the {{accessToken}} variable and sent as a Bearer token. Refresh/logout use the HttpOnly refresh cookie plus the CSRF header (run Get CSRF cookie first).

request.description: Sets the XSRF-TOKEN cookie. Run before Refresh or Logout.
Returns the access token; the refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie. 5 wrong PINs lock the account.
Rotates the refresh cookie. Reusing an old one revokes the whole session family.

request.description: Open Plaid Link with this token. Sandbox: pick any bank and sign in with user_good / pass_good. Customers and agents.
The one-time public token from Plaid Link. accountId is optional: without it the first checking or savings account is used. The access token stays on the server, encrypted.
